clips.title: The story
paras: A voice now comes from the Faded Shadowhide Pendant, found in the Redridge Mountains. The Shadowhide gnolls wore it to receive orders from Morganth, and the delayed message is a spell cast by Theocritus.

The Shadowhide gnolls of the Redridge Mountains follow Morganth and coordinate their movements through enchanted pendants. From his sanctuary at Tower Azora, High Mage Theocritus studied the talismans and devised a spell to breach their magical link. His broadcast took weeks to appear. This faded pendant proves the gnolls’ communication can be intercepted, giving Theocritus a way to disrupt Morganth’s reach.
